reviews.text:
We had a record breaking rainfall the day after my pool was cleaned. Then, we had more rain on the weekend. My pool was as blue as could be! It’s a Christmas miracle. No, our technician Chris Martin is a miracle! 😉

Claffey Pools and Chris have been the best pool service we have hired. Chris is faithfully here on our clean day every week. He puts in the time and effort to ensure our pool is looking good and functioning well. When we have had issues with our pool, the service team has pulled through to fix the issues. We are so appreciative of Chris and all his has done to keep our pool in great shape. He truly cares and it shows!
reviews.author: Christi Merkle

reviews.text: Jason, Kyle, and Duffy were an absolute pleasure to work with. They not only answered all our questions but also went above and beyond to ensure we felt confident throughout the process. Everything was handled promptly and professionally, and they were always responsive when we reached out. Their insight and expertise were truly invaluable as we repaired our pool. We’re grateful for their support and look forward to working with Claffey again in the future.
reviews.author: fabfikes

reviews.text: The entire process, from start to finish, was fantastic. Everyone involved, Jasen, Mike, Sue, and all the others, were pleasant and professional. The pool turned out to be as beautiful as expected. Claffey built our pool 22 years ago and we made another good decision to have Claffey replaster the pool.
reviews.author: Dave Brillhart

reviews.text: Justin Hennessy, our service technician from Claffey Pools, truly went above and beyond when replacing one of our malfunctioning pumps. He took the time to thoroughly test everything before leaving, ensuring the system was running perfectly, speeds were correctly set, and all valves were properly adjusted. Outstanding service! I highly recommend Claffey’s and especially Justin for any pool needs.
reviews.author: Chris Armstrong

reviews.text:
So glad I called Claffey to do repairs on my pool! Jason and Kyle were awesome. The attention to detail was superb….and I’m pretty picky!
Thank you for taking pride in your work! Awesome job!!
reviews.author: Holly Hardee

reviews.text: Claffey Pool remodel removed and then installed a new pool slide and diving board. They did a great job from communicating by email or text to the job itself and follow up. Thanks to Jasen, Ryan, Gerrado and the crew!
reviews.author: Todd Grant

reviews.text: John is my technician and he does a great job! Very attentive and detailed.  We just renovated our pool and couldn’t be more pleased!
reviews.author: katie Ruelas

reviews.text: Talk about a total transformation! Claffey took our dated and run down back yard and turned it into a beautiful oasis. They remodeled our existing pool and built a new cabana. No detail was too small and every step was overseen with great care.  We were so grateful for Shawn. His amazing attention to detail and availability are truly invaluable.  He made this very long (9 months) project tolerable.  Would highly recommend Claffey, Shawn, and every worker who contributed for any project.
reviews.author: lauri Horton

data.summary: Reviews show strong authenticity signals with specific, varied customer experiences, particularly on Google. The company has a long, established history. The primary concern is the rating discrepancy with Yelp, but the provided Yelp data lacks review content for analysis. The strategic Google sample is overwhelmingly positive but detailed. No evidence of fake review patterns in the content provided.
fake_signals: Strategic sample of Google reviews shows only 5-star, lacks balanced perspective
Google HQ reviews are anonymous and non-substantive, appear to be placeholders or spam

positive_evidence: Mention of returning for replaster after 22 years implies longevity and customer retention

authentic_signals: Specific employee names and project details in Google reviews
Varied writing styles and specific scenarios (rainfall, 22-year relationship, remodel details)
Long business history (39 years) and BBB accreditation since 1991
complaint_patterns: Potential service quality or communication issues (inferred from Yelp rating)
data.discrepancy_explanation: Significant rating discrepancy between Google (4.9) and Yelp (3.2). Yelp's lower rating suggests a different customer segment or potential negative bias not captured in the Google sample. BBB A+ rating indicates strong complaint resolution.
